jobs.description:
To strengthen our Global IT team, Manuchar is looking for a technically curious and solution-oriented 
Service Desk Engineer. Based at our headquarters in 
Antwerp (Merksem), you will support colleagues worldwide and help ensure they can work efficiently with the right IT tools and systems.
 

You will join an international IT environment where no two days are the same. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, takes initiative and is eager to further develop their IT expertise.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 

• Provide first-line IT support to colleagues worldwide and support other IT service agents across our global network. 

• Troubleshoot issues involving Microsoft 365, Windows, hardware, networks, servers and internally developed applications. 

• Manage end-user devices, including installation, configuration, maintenance and replacement. 

• Support IT onboarding by setting up accounts, access rights and equipment. 

• Manage incidents and service requests through our ticketing system. 

• Maintain technical documentation, user instructions and IT asset records.  

Your Profile
 
 

• You hold a Bachelor's degree or graduate diploma in IT, or equivalent qualifications through experience, combined with relevant hands-on IT support experience. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
Microsoft 365 and Windows environments. Knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Active Directory, Windows Autopilot, networking or server infrastructure is a plus. 

• You have strong troubleshooting skills and enjoy investigating technical issues independently. 

• You are communicative, approachable, service-minded and comfortable supporting colleagues remotely and in person. 

• You are hands-on, take initiative and are eager to further develop your technical expertise. 

• You enjoy working in an international environment and adapt easily to changing priorities. 

• You are fluent in 
English. Knowledge of Dutch or Spanish is an advantage.  

What We Offer
 
 

• A varied role in a global IT environment with exposure to different technologies and technical challenges. 

• Opportunities to grow towards second-line support, IT Engineering or other IT specialisations. 

• An attractive compensation package including hospitalization and group insurance, meal vouchers, mobile phone with subscription, collective bonus, and more. 

• A supportive team and work environment focused on communication, well-being and professional development.  

Can't wait to join our team?
 

Send your CV and cover letter through our online recruitment tool, Talent Recruiter.
 

Questions? Contact Lise Polfliet, HR Assistant, at recruitment@manuchar.com.
 

Manuchar, a multinational of Belgian origin
 

Manuchar is a leading distributor of chemicals across high-growth markets and also trades commodities such as steel and polymers. With more than 40 years of local presence and over 180 locations worldwide, we provide end-to-end commercial, supply chain and financing solutions.
 

Our mission:“Connecting the World. For Better Lives."

Join Michael Page as a Recruiter and play a key role in connecting top talent with leading companies across Belgium. You will manage the full recruitment cycle while building long-term relationships with both candidates and clients.

Client Details

Michael Page is one of the world's leading specialized recruitment firms, operating in more than 35 countries. We offer a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where ambition, performance, and personal development are truly valued.

Description

• Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for permanent positions.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with candidates and clients.
• Source, screen, and interview qualified professionals.
• Advise clients on market trends, salary benchmarks, and hiring strategies.
• Negotiate offers and support candidates throughout the hiring process.
• Contribute to business development and identify new opportunities within your market.

• Bachelor's degree minimum.
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and business development.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
• Proactive, ambitious, and results-oriented personality.
• Previous experience in recruitment, sales, customer service, or business development is a plus.

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 

• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Between 5 to 15 stops/day

• Never on weekends or on holidays

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby + truck cannot be taken home)

Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 4 December. You will be working in the night shift (22u00 - 06u00).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 21u10 

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Our client is a leading Belgian construction and engineering group active in construction, real estate development and concessions.

With an international presence and approximately 10,000 employees across more than 25 countries, the company delivers complex construction and infrastructure projects in Belgium and abroad.

 

As a Project Buyer, you are responsible for managing procurement activities within an assigned scope of construction projects. Working closely with the project teams, you ensure that works, supplies and services are purchased under the best possible conditions, while taking into account technical requirements, project planning, costs, risks and QHSES standards.

You report to the Head Buyer and work in close collaboration with the various project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage procurement activities independently within your assigned scope.
• Handle the full procurement process, from defining the sourcing strategy and preparing requests for quotation to negotiating and finalizing contracts.
• Advise project teams on procurement matters and provide input on market conditions and sourcing opportunities.
• Work closely with multidisciplinary teams, including engineering, design, construction planning, finance, legal and procurement specialists.
• Identify and engage with potential subcontractors, suppliers and service providers.
• Prepare requests for quotation based on technical and operational requirements provided by the project teams.
• Analyze and compare offers from both a technical and financial perspective.
• Organize clarification meetings and lead commercial negotiations.
• Support project teams in the supplier selection and award decision process.
• Ensure proper contract documentation and administrative follow-up.

Your Profile

We are open to candidates with either a technical background in civil engineering or previous experience in procurement:

Civil Engineering / Construction background

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering or a related technical discipline.
• You have a solid understanding of civil works and are interested in developing your career towards procurement and purchasing.
• Exposure to construction projects, technical coordination, subcontractors, tendering or cost estimation would be an asset.
Procurement / Buyer background

• Alternatively, you have previous experience in procurement or purchasing within the construction or civil engineering sector.
• You are familiar with sourcing, subcontracting, supplier management and contract negotiations.
• You have a good understanding of procurement processes and contract administration.
Regardless of your background, you bring:

• A strong interest in construction procurement and the commercial aspects of projects.
• A good understanding of civil works, particularly concrete, reinforcement, formwork and post-tensioning, or the ability to develop this knowledge.
• Excellent level of Dutch, both written and spoken (mandatory), and a good command of English.
• Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills.
• The ability to work collaboratively with technical and operational stakeholders.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

Our client is a family-owned industrial company based in Alken (Belgium), specialized in solutions for industrial electric motors, gearmotors, pumps, and fans. They are currently looking for an experienced CNC Programmer / Operator to join their production team.The company offers a solid onboarding program, giving you time to adapt and grow into the role.In this position, you will work in a technical production environment where precision, programming, and machine knowledge are key.Your responsibilities include:
• Setting up cutting tools, positioning, and clamping workpieces
• Setting machining parameters (speed, feed, lubrication, etc.)
• Operating and programming CNC milling machines
• Making adjustments and modifications to machining programs
• Creating basic CNC programs from technical drawings and part lists
• Performing basic preventive and corrective machine maintenance
• Working with materials such as plastics, composites, ferrous metals (cast iron, steel), and non-ferrous metals (aluminium, zinc)
We are looking for a skilled and motivated CNC professional:
• Minimum 2 years of experience in CNC machining
• Experience with MAZAK/Siemens/Fanuc CNC Machines
• Ability to read and work from technical drawings
• Good level of English
• European nationality
• Driving licence B
• Hands-on technical mindset and precision working style
• Ability to work independently and in a structured way👉 If you recognize yourself in this profile, you are the ideal candidate for this position.

jobs.occupation: Concrete Worker - day work - high salary!
jobs.description:
Job Description:

A concrete manufacturing company specializing in precast concrete products is looking for a Production Worker.

Your responsibilities include:

• Daily production of precast concrete elements

• Pouring concrete into moulds

• Preparing reinforcement structures

• Operating an overhead crane when required

Candidate Profile:

We are looking for a candidate who:

• Has experience in the concrete, construction, or building sector

• Can operate an overhead crane or is willing to learn

• Can communicate in English or Dutch

• Is not afraid of physically demanding and hands-on work

Our client is a well-established transport and maintenance company based in Bilzen (Belgium), specialized in the servicing and repair of trucks, trailers, and commercial vehicles.In this role, you are responsible for the maintenance, diagnostics, and repair of heavy-duty vehicles in a modern and fully equipped workshop. You ensure that all vehicles are delivered in safe and optimal working condition.Your responsibilities include:
• Performing maintenance and repair work on trucks and trailers
• Diagnosing mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues
• Carrying out preventive maintenance and breakdown repairs
• Inspecting vehicles and ensuring road safety standards
• Working with modern diagnostic tools and workshop equipment
• Ensuring high-quality and efficient repair work
• Collaborating with experienced technicians in a professional workshopWorking hours:
• 08:00 – 18:30or
• 10:30 – 18:00 (Mon–Fri) + Saturday 08:00 – 12:00 (depending on schedule)
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on truck mechanic:
• Experience as a truck or trailer mechanic
• Knowledge of mechanics, pneumatics, hydraulics, and electrical systems
• Ability to work independently and in a team
• Good level of English
• European nationality
• Category B driving licence (mandatory)
• Category C driving licence is a plus
• Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills👉 If you recognize yourself in this profile, you are the ideal candidate for this position.

Our client is one of the top 3 automotive dealer groups in Belgium, with more than 16,600 new vehicles sold in 2023. The group represents leading brands such as Audi, Volkswagen, Škoda, SEAT, CUPRA, VW Commercial Vehicles, BMW, MINI, Jaguar, and Land Rover.To support their continued growth in the Limburg region, they are currently looking for an experienced Panel Beater with strong skills in vehicle body repair and preparation.In this role, you will work in a modern automotive workshop focused on high-quality body repair and finishing.Your responsibilities include:
• Preparing new parts and repairing dents and body damage
• Working with metal and aluminium components
• Filling, sanding, cleaning, masking, and applying primer
• Operating primer drying systems
• Restoring vehicle body structures through welding, grinding, and panel replacement
• Comparing damaged parts with new components and reporting missing parts
• Transforming damaged components into repairable or new parts
• Performing quality and functionality checks (vehicle readiness, calibration, ADAS systems, etc.)
• Ensuring vehicles are fully prepared and safe for delivery
We are looking for an experienced and skilled automotive body repair professional:
• Minimum 3 years of experience as a panel beater or body repair technician
• Strong knowledge of vehicle body preparation and repair techniques
• Experience with metal and aluminium bodywork
• Ability to perform filling, sanding, masking, and priming
• Experience in welding, grinding, and panel replacement
• Good level of English
• European nationality
• Category B driving licence is a plus👉 If you recognize yourself in this profile, you are the ideal candidate for this position.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
A growing company that packages and stores frozen and chilled food products to order for European customers. By 2027, the company aims to have over 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging orders. You'll work in a respectful environment where collaboration and job satisfaction are key.

On behalf of our client in Roeselare , Let's Work is looking for a packer of food products.

In this role, you will be responsible for carefully packing various food products in a cool working environment of 5 to 10°C. Together with the line manager and colleagues, you will ensure that every product is packed correctly. You can choose between day shifts from 7.45 am to 3.30 pm or afternoon shifts from 3.45 pm to 11.30 pm.

Do you enjoy playing an active part in a smooth production process and do you have an eye for neat packaging? Then be sure to read on!

What does your working day as a packer look like?

 
• 
You will carefully pack various types of food products in accordance with the prescribed procedures

 
• 
On the packing line, you'll work alongside the line supervisor and colleagues

 
• 
The right products are packaged correctly, with quality always being the top priority

 
• 
Whilst working, you'll be in a cool environment of 5 to 10°C

 
• 
You have gained your first stable work experience as a packer in the food sector

 
• 
Working with precision and an eye for quality characterise your approach

 
• 
Working as part of a team is smooth and enjoyable

 
• 
A flexible attitude comes in very handy

 
• 
For communication in the workplace, you speak good Dutch, English or French; basic English is required

During the busy holiday period in December, extra help is needed for packing products. You will temporarily work in a production environment, making sure everything is packed neatly and quickly so orders can be shipped on time.

A typical workday includes receiving products, checking their quality, and carefully packing them at a brisk pace. You work together with other packers and follow instructions closely. Keeping up the pace is crucial because orders must be ready for timely delivery.

Interested in rolling up your sleeves and helping out during this period? Apply quickly and support the team with your effort and positive attitude!

• Able to work quickly and keep up with a fast pace

• Motivated and committed

• Fluent in Dutch, French, or English

• No experience required

• Available in December for a temporary job

jobs.occupation: Warehouse Operator | Machelen | Reach Truck & Stacker Certificate
jobs.description:
For a company specialized in airport lighting located in Machelen, we are looking for an Order Picker. As an Order Picker, you will work in a production environment where lighting systems are manufactured and processed. 
Your responsibilities: 
 

 
• Operating a reach truck to store goods and orders correctly. 
 
•  
Preparing orders using a scanner. 

 
• Carefully packing goods for shipment. 
 
•  
Loading and unloading trucks. 

 
• Assisting with the overall organization of the warehouse and replenishing stock when needed. 
 

 
• Working quickly, accurately, and with great attention to detail. 

 
• You are versatile and enjoy working in a dynamic logistics environment. 
 

 
• You hold a valid Reach Truck Certificate. 
 

 
• You also possess a valid Stacker (Pedestrian Stacker) Certificate. 
 

 
• Experience in stacking and moving containers is considered a strong asset. 
 

 
• You can communicate in Dutch, French, or English. 
 
•  
As the team is mainly French-speaking, a willingness to integrate and learn is important. 

 
• You are flexible and willing to work overtime during busy periods. 
 

 
• You enjoy working as part of a team and carry out your tasks accurately and responsibly.

jobs.occupation: Senior Legal Counsel - Real Estate & Franchise Law
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading consumer-focused retail organisation operating a large network of company-owned and franchise locations across Belgium and neighbouring markets. With a strong brand portfolio and significant market presence, the business serves a broad customer base through a multi-site retail model.The organisation is entering an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with ongoing investments in operational excellence, digital innovation, store development and franchise expansion. As legal complexity continues to increase, the company is strengthening its in-house legal capabilities to provide closer business support and further reduce reliance on external counsel.The legal team operates as a true business partner, supporting senior management and operational stakeholders across a wide range of legal disciplines. This environment offers a unique opportunity to develop expertise across almost every aspect of commercial law within a dynamic retail setting.The culture is entrepreneurial, pragmatic and commercially driven. Individuals are encouraged to take ownership, challenge constructively and provide practical solutions that enable business growth while appropriately managing legal risk.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the primary legal business partner for the Belgian business units.
• Lead all franchise and commercial real estate matters.
• Advise on franchise development, restructurings and franchise disputes.
• Support commercial lease negotiations, store openings, relocations and property projects.
• Manage negotiations with landlords, franchisees and external stakeholders.
• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements.
• Advise business stakeholders on consumer law, commercial law and day-to-day operational matters.
• Manage material claims, disputes and litigation matters.
• Coordinate and supervise relationships with external law firms.
• Oversee corporate housekeeping activities, including governance documentation, shareholder resolutions, appointments and corporate restructurings.
• Maintain and further develop contract management processes and documentation.
• Participate in multidisciplinary business and transformation projects.
• Support digital, e-commerce, IT, compliance and data protection initiatives.
• Monitor legal and regulatory developments impacting the business.
• Contribute to legal efficiency initiatives and increased internalisation of legal work.

• Master's degree in Belgian Law.
• 8 to 12 years of relevant legal experience.
• Strong expertise in Belgian commercial real estate law.
• Strong expertise in Belgian franchise law.
• Experience within retail, franchise, consumer-facing or multi-site environments.
• Proven experience negotiating leases, franchise agreements and commercial contracts.
• Fluent Dutch and French.
• Professional proficiency in English.
• Ability to operate autonomously and act as a trusted business partner.
• Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
• Commercially minded, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.
• Structured, proactive and hands-on personality.

Join Kuehne+Nagel in Geel as an experienced order picker and earn €16,3753/hour plus €8 meal vouchers working in a 2-shift system! In this varied role, you will combine active order picking with quality control and warehouse administration. You will ensure top quality for renowned brands and make sure every shipment is in perfect condition.

Ready to take the next step in your logistics career? Send your CV to talentcenter1@randstad.be or call us directly at 011 54 92 85!

VG 458/BUOSA

 

• Minimum of 6 months to 1 year of experience in a warehouse setting or order picking. 

• Proven experience working with a handheld scanner is required. 

• Good command of either Dutch or English. 

• Willing to work in a 2-shift rotation on a long-term basis. 

• Must have your own transport to commute to the site in Geel.  

 
 
 

• Order picking goods in the warehouse using a handheld scanner. 

• Conducting accurate quality control checks on picked orders. 

• Checking and monitoring physical inventory and stock discrepancies. 

• Handling the required warehouse administration within the system. 

• Reporting deviations and safeguarding overall quality standards.

Are you passionate about industrial technology and do you gain energy from solving technical challenges?

For our sites in Neder-over-Heembeek and Brucargo, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician who maintains and optimises industrial installations with dedication and expertise.

You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability of our technical systems. We invest in safety, training and your development, and we value your technical expertise. Together, we build a future based on innovation, reliability and teamwork.

Your responsibilities

 
• Preventive maintenance: carry out preventive maintenance according to the maintenance plan and inspect machines to avoid breakdowns.
 
• Corrective & improvement maintenance: analyse and resolve faults, replace or adjust parts, consult technical documentation and ensure optimal machine performance.
 
• Optimisation: analyse recurring issues and propose improvement actions to increase performance and availability.
 
• Use of CMMS: record interventions, write fault analyses, prepare reports and monitor stock levels.
 
• Safety: ensure a clean and safe working environment and actively contribute to safety improvements.
 
• Support & training: provide technical support to colleagues and operational teams.
 
• Quality & environment: work in accordance with current procedures (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001).

 
• Solid technical background (mechanics, electricity or electromechanics). 
 
• Autonomous, thorough and solution‑oriented. 
 
• Experience with industrial installations is an asset. Knowledge of CMMS systems is a plus. 
 
• Strong safety awareness, quality‑oriented and eager to learn. 
 
• Willing to work in a 3‑shift system (Mon–Fri). 
 
• Excellent command of English; knowledge of French / Dutch is an advantage

Aluvision is a fast-growing international company and a market leader in innovative modular exhibition systems for exhibits & events, retail, and interior design. Our high-quality, sustainable solutions are trusted by global brands and partners to create impactful and flexible environments.
 

To support our continued growth, we are expanding our presence in Italy and are looking for a driven 
Sales Manager Italy to accelerate our commercial success in this key market.
 

As Sales Manager Italy, you grow our customer portfolio through active prospecting and lasting partnerships. You combine commercial drive with technical understanding to advise customers. You report directly to the Sales Director.

 

•  

A professional sales experience of minimum 5 years
  

•  

Experience in B2B sales, business development, field sales or account management, with success in acquiring new customers.
  

•  

A proactive hunter mentality, strong communication and negotiation skills, and an independent, structured approach.
  

•  

Technical understanding and solution-oriented selling skills; experience in exhibitions, events or display systems is a plus.
  

•  

Fluent Italian, a good command of English, and commercial or technical education or equivalent experience.
  

•  

Willingness to travel across Italy for approximately 60% of your working time.

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for an Accounting Specialist. You will join an international environment where Finance, Operations, HR, Tax, and Real Estate work closely together. This role exists to ensure that accounting and reporting processes across multiple markets are carried out accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who is analytically strong, communicates fluently, and feels comfortable in a dynamic and collaborative culture.

Your responsibilities

• 
Coordinate the administration of invoices and obligations related to leasing, housekeeping, payroll, property taxes, and travel expenses.

• 
Monitor budgets and analyze deviations in recurring costs and monthly closings.

• 
Oversee reconciliations, intercompany positions, and payroll reconciliations.

• 
Prepare VAT, property tax, and other tax filings in collaboration with the Tax department.

• 
Support external audits, year-end closing, and the preparation of statutory financial statements.

• 
Assist in the integration of new or acquired stores into accounting processes.

• 
Contribute to ESG data collection, budget preparation, and process improvements.

• 
Support and coach team members and new colleagues where necessary.

Your profile

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
At least 5 years of experience in accounting.

• 
Experience with financial statements, IFRS, and local GAAP.

• 
Experience in services or retail is required.

• 
Experience with SAP; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• 
Experience with ERP/CRM migrations and UAT is an advantage.

• 
Fluent in English and French; German is a strong plus.

• 
Strong skills in Excel and Microsoft Office.

• 
Accurate, independent, communicative, and solution-oriented.

For a growing organisation in the services sector we are looking for a Finance Operations Specialist. 

You will work closely with local accounting teams and other internal stakeholders across Europe.

Your Responsibilities

• 
Monitor expenses and commitments for real estate projects across Europe

• 
Support the preparation and review of local GAAP accounting memos

• 
Manage the daily administration of invoices and purchase orders

• 
Review and analyze invoice postings, including VAT and entity details

• 
Analyze new real estate projects such as construction, renovation, and maintenance

• 
Support communication with external parties such as contractors, suppliers, and government authorities

• 
Assist with the financial reporting of investment projects (actuals, budget, and forecast)

• 
Follow up on payment schedules together with local accounting teams

• 
Support month-end and quarter-end closings within real estate accounting

• 
Assist with depreciation, capitalization, and reconciliations

• 
Support internal and external audits

• 
Contribute to ESG reporting

• 
Assist in implementing procedures and control systems in line with internal standards

• 
Support the rollout of control processes across different markets

• 
Support process improvements and special accounting projects

Your Profile

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience

• 
1–3 years of experience in accounting

• 
Experience in a real estate environment is a plus

• 
Fluent in English

• 
Experience in an international or shared services environment is a plus

• 
Knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP is an asset

• 
Proficient in Microsoft Office, with advanced Excel skills

• 
Experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus
